review_notes: day ፳፫ ዘነግህ has a ምስባክ but NO ወንጌል — verified at 900dpi: the three ምስባክ verses run straight into the ዘቅዳሴ ጢሞ፡ ፪ incipit, and the citation column has no ወንጌል row between ዘነግህ ምስባክ and ዘቅዳሴ. The absence is real, not a faint line.
